subject: Request: short sandbox buffer while we fix adapter flakiness
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@cobaltai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short sandbox buffer while we fix adapter flakiness

Hi Tessa —

Quick note from our engineering lead: after last week's SDK update the Kafka adapter we use to stream predictions has become flaky during load. We're blocked on a regression test and it looks like the fix will take the team 7–10 business days. Our pilot (the seeded test runs) was due to ramp next Tuesday — we won't be able to hit the demo window without extra sandbox capacity and a little more runway.

Can Redwood provide a small sandbox buffer or short extension of the trial credits while we iron this out? We'll need roughly 250k tokens of buffer to complete validation and the demo. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the error logs (attached).

Attachments: sdk-log-snippet.txt, error-screenshot.png

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Integrations, CobaltAI
alex@cobaltai.com
+1 415-555-0148

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@cobaltai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short sandbox buffer while we fix adapter flakiness

Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the regression. We can help — I just kicked this up internally. Two quick asks so we can expedite: 1) can you confirm the exact token estimate (you noted ~250k) and timeframe for the fix (7–10 business days is fine but narrower is helpful), and 2) can you paste the CI job link or the failing test ID?

Ben, I requested a small sandbox buffer and 250k tokens of trial credit to keep their pilot window intact while engineering works the fix. Can you approve an interim top-up (no contractual change, purely sandbox credit) and confirm any additional guardrails we should apply?

Alex — once Ben confirms I will issue a short-term sandbox credit and loop in Marissa (CS) for onboarding support and to update the mutual action plan.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-17T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short sandbox buffer while we fix adapter flakiness

Tessa —

Approve a one-time 300k token sandbox credit. Increase slightly from their estimate to avoid a second request if tests take longer. Conditions: credit expires in 14 days from issuance; CS must confirm the pilot date is rescheduled in the MAP; and we add a guardrail to prevent export of production data during the top-up. Marissa, please confirm you'll own the MAP update and post-mortem assistance if needed.

I'll ask RevOps to track this as a non-billable credit tied to DEAL-14872. Tessa, please include the credit note in the HubSpot record and attach the logs for the credit review doc.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@cobaltai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short sandbox buffer while we fix adapter flakiness

Alex / Team —

Thanks — we have issued a one-time 300k token sandbox credit. It will appear on your console under Billing > Trial Credits. The credit expires 2026-07-02 (14 days). We've temporarily disabled exports for the sandbox project and flagged the environment for monitoring; if you need us to extend the window after the post-mortem, ping me and include the failing CI link you promised earlier so we can correlate logs.

Next steps: 1) Alex — share the failing test ID/CI link (or paste it into this thread). 2) We'll update the mutual action plan with the new demo date once you've confirmed internal timelines. 3) I'll assign a CS engineer to be on standby for the next three test runs.

Appreciate the quick coordination — fingers crossed for a fast fix.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
